Retain physical Project/Resource ownership and historical attribution. Both shared Projects and all four Resources need independent coverage. Resource mounts do not grant enrollment or export. Public native transport, content/alias projection and remediation remain N4 review, with existing import/recurrence guards intact.

N2 owns native hosting/registry; N3 writers and durable coordination; N4 transport/privacy; N5 disposable migration rehearsals and active-target protection; N6 production migration/activation; N7/N8 legacy removal and task-location UI. None is authorized here. **STOP FOR USER REVIEW.**
